name: The soldiers at the road
greeting: The nearest soldier lets his sword point fall into the mud. The other watches Senn before doing the same.
lines: Soldier: He said Greyfen would leave us hungry if we stopped taking what passed.
Kael: I cannot promise nobody will ask what you took. I can promise supper is not a reward for obeying him.
Kael: Then you speak for yourselves. Lowering a weapon does not sign your name to anyone else's account.
The road clears. Senn remains beside the table, without a line of men between his answers and the people he hurt.
